description: This file captures the ambient droning sound that evokes the atmosphere of a space station. It is a soothing yet eerie sound, created by the constant hum and buzz of the space station's machinery and equipment. The sound is reminiscent of being in a spaceship, surrounded by the vast emptiness of space and the unyielding hum of technology. This file is perfect for creating a space-themed ambience or for adding a touch of realism to any space-related project.
name: Space Station Drone
